notes.title: Testing offline rewards + Makeship Collaboration
notes.content:
We wanted to thank everyone for the continuous support and feedback! With the last update we added some minor suggestions to make quality of life better (for the full list of changes, check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2513240/view/4184484271476769025?l=english]latest patch notes[/url]) and we continue to work on the bigger issues. Right now, we test offline rewards and we're looking for the best solutions to prevent selling items accidentally and/or locking them in inventory so they don't get sorted. 

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/hero-plushie?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=reveal-post&utm_campaign=makeship-hero-plushie][img]https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0125/8261/7145/files/DIY_Hero_Tale_Plush-SV3-P-1_1000x.png.webp?v=1715385887[/img][/url]

The other news we are very happy to announce is that we have our first merchandise ever, thanks to Makeship! He looks so smug, isn't he? We need to get to 200 units for the plushie to be produced and we can't do it without your help :D So go get your Hero companion (and his trusthworthy companion sir Stick) to bring him on adventures anywhere you go! 

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/hero-plushie?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=reveal-post&utm_campaign=makeship-hero-plushie]Click the link to get there![/url]

notes.title: Hero Tale - Release sale
notes.content:
Hero Tale is released now on Steam and all other platforms and to celebrate that, Hero Tale and all DLCs are 20% off!

Now that Hero Tale is finished, what does that mean for the game? First thing first, we're not abandoning Hero Tale. There is still an update with 11 more languages pending (we just got translations the night before), some bug fixes, quality of life updates and maybe a little balance.

We read all reviews and community hub discussions and we take feedback from here, even if our social media gal doesn't respond to all of them. Thank you for being so active in this little community! 

We may have some ideas for Hero Tale for later but they're for later. After 5 years of developement, we want to catch our breath and work on something different... That will be announced on our social media soon 😉

notes.title: We hear you: dropping DLC prices
notes.content:
First thing first, we want to thank you becasue WOW we did not expect so many people in the first week of Early Access on Steam! We can't even put into words how thankful we are!!

When Hero Tale debuted on the Google Play Store almost 3 years ago, immense positive reception was quite shocking for two people who were giving their all to create the first version of the game. It went a long way, through all graphical changes, gameplay improvements, bugs that sneakily persisted through updates until they were squashed and so much more. It is still a little unbelievable that the team of two had the ability to expand to eight people!

And now that we're nearing the end of the development of Hero Tale, we want to give our sincere thanks to the people who made making this game possible: to you! 

Yes, you! 

Everyone who played Hero Tale, supported us by purchasing pricey Fairies, found bugs and hyped the game while we were slowly painting every single leaf on the map and animating every swing of the enemies towards our Boy. 

We especially want to thank everyone who could afford our more expensive Fairy tiers. They were expensive but because of that we got enough funding to make sure Hero Tale will be finished (which is not so obvious in indie development :D). 

Now that the future of the game looks bright, we are finally able to follow the loudest feedback we were getting from the very beginning: that the Fairies are too expensive. 
We’re going to drop the prices of Tier 2 and Tier 3 so they can be more affordable to everyone. 

And for everyone who bought Fairies at a higher price, we are planning exclusive in-game content, so stay tuned!

Once again, thank you so very much! Hero Tale wouldn’t be the game it is today without you!

Weird Johnny Studio Team
